name: EVE Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a global supplier of lithium battery technologies, serving both the Chinese domestic market and international clients. The company's diverse product range features primary lithium batteries, including lithium thionyl chloride, lithium-manganese dioxide, lithium-ion capacitors, and micro lithium cells. Additionally, it manufactures various rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, offering cylindrical, pouch, and prismatic cell configurations, alongside aluminum-cased versions, as well as polymer-based prismatic, cylindrical, and compact "bean" cells. Beyond individual cells, EVE Energy develops complete power systems, notably for pure electric buses and electric mini-vehicles. It also provides comprehensive energy storage solutions, encompassing residential ESS products, telecom backup battery units, and microgrid applications. The company's primary lithium batteries are widely utilized in fields such as smart metering, automotive electronics, intelligent security systems, data communication, and smart transportation. Its lithium-ion batteries, on the other hand, are essential components for consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and large-scale energy storage industries. EVE Energy Co., Ltd. was established in 2001 and is headquartered in Huizhou, China.
